purpose: Proves a touched criterion's bound tests are real: they enter only through the app entry and the shared harness, and at least one goes red when each Code Node symbol implementing the criterion is broken, so a test that stays green against broken code is reported vacuous.
responsibilities: resolve the scope: --acs, else the touchedAcIds of the newest REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD, else the --fbs acIds
structural check over every bound test file of each touched criterion: imports, module mocks, and silent defaults in the Code Node symbols

mutation proof: for each symbol-level Code Node of each touched criterion apply stub-to-throw, no-op and call removal, and for each file-level Code Node of a touched criterion on a path that is not source (not .js, .mjs or .cjs and not one of the code extensions the interface lists) apply fileBlank (blank the file), in a scratch worktree and run only that criterion's bound tests
print one verdict line, emit json, and with --record write rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test-strength.json for the reviewed head

interfaces.name: rcf audit test-strength
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf audit test-strength [--acs <AC id>[,...] | --fbs <id>[,...]] [--record] [--json] [--jobs <n>] [--mutant-timeout <seconds>] [--max-mutants <n>]
PASS: "test-strength: PASS <n> criteria at <h7>: structural <n>/<n>, mutants killed <k>/<total> (timeout <t>, notApplicable <a>)", exit 0. FAIL: "test-strength: FAIL <k> of <n> criteria at <h7>: <AC id> <reason>[; ...]", exit 4, reasons "imports <path> (not the app entry or the harness)", "mocks <specifier> (not a declared edge)", "silent default <name> in <path#symbol>", "vacuous: <operator> on <path#symbol> survived <k> bound tests", "no Code Node", "no symbol-level Code Node", "no mutable symbol <path#symbol>", "unbound". BLOCKED: "test-strength: BLOCKED <n> criteria at <h7>: structural a/b, mutants killed x/y (timeout t, notApplicable n, blocked m): <blocked AC ids with their files>", exit 5, the BLOCKED exit (exit 1 is the bin's unexpected-failure code), for a criterion the audit cannot read (result blocked, reason "TEST_STRENGTH_UNSUPPORTED"). When a run has both a blocked and a failing criterion the fail verdict and its exit code win: the verdict word is FAIL, exit 4, the FAIL line gains ", blocked <m>: <blocked AC ids with their files>" at its end, and the summary line still counts the blocked criteria and lists their ids. Operators apply to functions, methods and function-valued initialisers; a class symbol expands to its methods; any other symbol fails "no mutable symbol". The structural check runs for every criterion in scope first; mutants run only for criteria that pass it. Sources: JavaScript ES modules and CommonJS (.js, .mjs, .cjs), and .ts, .tsx and .vue files as US-19904 rules. A bound test file on any other path, or a symbol-level Code Node (<path#symbol>) on any other file, makes its criterion BLOCKED (result blocked, reason "TEST_STRENGTH_UNSUPPORTED", a detail naming the file) while the run continues for the other criteria, and no stderr line reads "is not a supported source"; so does a Code Node file holding non-erasable TypeScript syntax (a detail naming the file and "non-erasable TypeScript syntax") and a .tsx Code Node file the JSX scan cannot read (detail "JSX scan failed at <file>:<line>:<col>: <what the scanner met>"). A file-level Code Node (a path with no #symbol) on a code file in another language, the code extensions being .ts .tsx .jsx .py .rb .go .java .kt .rs .php .cs .swift, exits 2 "test-strength: <path> is not a supported source (JavaScript ESM or CommonJS)". A file-level Code Node on a .js, .mjs or .cjs file is never mutated, because source code needs symbol granularity: a criterion with one and no symbol-level Code Node fails "no symbol-level Code Node". A file-level Code Node on any other path (docs, JSON, YAML, .github/ workflows, chain records) gets the fourth operator, fileBlank: the file is blanked in the scratch worktree, only the criterion's bound tests run, and at least one must go red, else the reason reads "vacuous: fileBlank on <path> survived <k> bound tests". <total> on the PASS line excludes notApplicable mutants. Usage exit 2: "test-strength: no rcf/test-strength.json; declare entry and harness", "test-strength: no scope; pass --acs or --fbs, or record a REVIEW verdict", "test-strength: <k> mutants exceed --max-mutants <n>; narrow the scope", an unknown AC id. --record needs a REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD whatever the scope flags (exit 2 "test-strength: --record needs a REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD"); --record refusals exit 4: dirty tree, or HEAD differing from the reviewed head outside rcf/verdicts/, rcf/verify-reports/ and FINALISE classes. Defaults: --jobs half the CPU count (at least 1), --mutant-timeout 120, --max-mutants 200.

interfaces.name: rcf/test-strength.json
interfaces.description: format: JSON in the project's rcf/ tree (criteria class, written by the test-author). { "entry": [ { "kind": "bin" | "module" | "worker", "path": <repo-relative path> } ] (one or more), "harness": [glob, ...] (one or more), "edge": [module specifier, ...] (the network edge, for example "node:http", "undici"), "clock": [module specifier, ...] (optional), "runners": [ { "files": [glob], "kind": "nodeTest" | "vitest" | "playwright", "argv": [...] } ] (optional; first match wins: each bound test file runs under the first entry whose files glob matches it; kind sets the default argv and the report the verb reads, argv overrides it; each kind's default argv carries the reporter the audit reads, nodeTest the TAP reporter, vitest and playwright their JSON reporter; an argv override replaces the whole argv and must carry its own reporter flag; an entry whose kind is none of nodeTest, vitest or playwright exits 2 with a stderr line starting "test-strength: malformed rcf/test-strength.json"), "runner": [argv with <file> and <name> placeholders] (optional, the legacy runner beside runners: a bound test file no runners entry matches falls to the legacy runner with today's exit-code rule, else kind nodeTest), "suiteCommand": <the project's RCF suite command, hygiene tests excluded, printing TAP> (optional; rcf build base-suite reads it) }. kind bin: the entry is spawned as a child process (a CLI such as rcf-lite: bin/rcf.js); module: imported by package name through the package exports map (a library); worker: the module the deploy configuration names as main, built as production builds it, invoked through the harness's fetch.

interfaces.name: TestStrengthReport v1
interfaces.description: fields: version (1), head (40-hex reviewed head), scope (acs | reviewVerdict | fbs), criteria (array of { acId, structural { result pass | fail, findings [string] }, mutants [ { symbol <path#symbol> (for fileBlank, the file-level Code Node's path), operator stubToThrow | noOp | callRemoval | fileBlank, result killed | survived | timeout | notApplicable, killedBy [test pointer] } ], result pass | fail | blocked, and for a blocked criterion reason "TEST_STRENGTH_UNSUPPORTED" and detail <naming the file, and the construct where one is the cause: "non-erasable TypeScript syntax", or "JSX scan failed at <file>:<line>:<col>: <what the scanner met>"> }), result (pass | fail: fail when any criterion fails), totals { criteria, structuralPassed, mutants (every generated mutant, notApplicable included), killed, survived, timeout, notApplicable }, wallMs, node.

notes: Code Node shape and limits: docs/code-nodes.md (symbol paths :26-33, the mark-complete gate :89-110, "Semantic drift is invisible" :129, which this check answers). The judgement layer (each clause pinned, flag honest) stays with Review (ReviewVerdict adequacy).
name: rcf audit test-strength: structural check of bound tests and the v1 mutation proof over Code Node symbols of touched criteria
